title: Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia - Rhapsody of the Forsaken
description:
Rhapsody of the Forsaken from Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia, which plays in the Minera Prison Island and Lighthouse areas. Good for areas like castles, athletic levels, tower/fortress areas and in general is very fitting for parts that require a higher degree of intensity.

WARNING: Not compatible with Blaargs or Yoshi.
